headline: Daily Market Snapshot — July 23, 2026
summary: US futures edged modestly lower on July 23 as 10Y Treasury yields climbed near 4.68% alongside firm oil prices driven by Houthi tanker attacks in the Red Sea. S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow had all closed fractionally lower on July 22 ahead of big-tech earnings from Alphabet and Tesla. KOSPI surged 3.7% overnight on AI chip demand optimism from Alphabet's capex boost.
